articles.author: Ian King, Mark Gurman, Vlad Savov
articles.title: Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook Seeks to Ease Fears of Weak iPhone Demand in China - Bloomberg
articles.description: Apple Inc.’s disappointing holiday-quarter outlook has cast a spotlight on its mounting problems in China, where the iPhone maker is struggling with the unexpected rise of Huawei Technologies Co. and an increasingly hostile business environment.
